name: Primal Pursuit 🦖
desc:
Welcome to Primal Pursuit, a game where humans battle dinosaurs for supremacy! One player becomes a powerful dinosaur while the survivors fight to escape. As a survivor, use weapons to survive and escape the island before time runs out. As a dinosaur, hunt down every human before they escape the island.
